message.content:
Second independent check. Is this M12 code-review finding a REAL, actionable bug/issue that should be fixed before merge? Read the code yourself. Be skeptical — confirm only if you can point to the concrete problem in the diff.

Lens: correctness
File: app/(customer)/account/page.tsx (Receipts section — payments.map(...) → href={`/account/receipt/${p.booking_id}`})
Title: Receipt download links 404 for any booking without a completed session
Detail: The Receipts section renders a "Download receipt" link for EVERY payment row returned by listCustomerPayments (no status filter). But a confirmed/upcoming booking already has a payments row with status "authorized" (created by payments.authorizeHold in app/(customer)/actions.ts at booking time, before any session exists). The receipt route at app/(customer)/account/receipt/[bookingId]/route.ts does `const [booking, session] = await Promise.all([getBooking, getSessionByBooking]); if (!booking || ... || !session) return 404`. Since getSessionByBooking returns null until the session is completed, every authorized-but-not-yet-completed booking produces a visible receipt link that returns HTTP 404 when clicked. A customer who just booked an upcoming session will see a broken download.

content.text:
This fully confirms the finding. The timeline is now clear:

1. **Booking time** (`app/(customer)/actions.ts`): inserts a `bookings` row, then `payments.authorizeHold` inserts a `payments` row with status `"authorized"`. No `sessions` row exists yet.
2. **Session start** (`app/(customer)/session/actions.ts:startSession`): only here is a `sessions` row created — and only when the customer/provider actually launches the call.
3. **Receipt page** (`account/page.tsx:163-191`): renders a "Download receipt" link for **every** payment row from `listCustomerPayments` (no status filter — `listCustomerPayments` at queries.ts:382 selects all payments for the customer, no `.eq("status", ...)`).
4. **Receipt route** (`receipt/[bookingId]/route.ts:30`): returns 404 if `!session` (via `getSessionByBooking`, which returns `null` when no session row exists).

So a customer who books an upcoming session immediately gets a `payments` row (status `authorized`), the account page renders a visible "Download receipt" link for it, and clicking that link returns HTTP 404 because `getSessionByBooking` returns `null` until the session has been started/completed.

The finding is concrete, correct, and reproducible from the diff. Let me note one nuance for the reason: the receipt requires a session row (started), not strictly "completed" — but the bug is the same either way: any confirmed-but-not-started booking yields a broken receipt link. The finding's core claim (link 404s for any booking without a session) is accurate.

input.reason:
Confirmed real and actionable by reading the code.

Timeline traced through the diff:
1. app/(customer)/actions.ts:65 — at BOOKING time, payments.authorizeHold runs, which (lib/integrations/payments/mock.ts:73-79) inserts a `payments` row with status "authorized". No session exists yet.
2. lib/db/queries.ts:382 listCustomerPayments selects ALL payments for the customer with NO status filter (just .eq("customer_id", ...)).
3. app/(customer)/account/page.tsx:164-189 maps over every payment row and renders a "Download receipt" <a href={`/account/receipt/${p.booking_id}`}> for each — including authorized-but-not-yet-started bookings.
4. app/(customer)/account/receipt/[bookingId]/route.ts:26-32 fetches getSessionByBooking and returns 404 when `!session`.
5. lib/db/queries.ts:295-306 getSessionByBooking does .maybeSingle() on the sessions table and returns null when no session row exists.
6. A sessions row is only inserted in app/(customer)/session/actions.ts:66-78 (startSession), i.e. when the call is actually launched — not at booking time.

Therefore any confirmed/upcoming booking (payment authorized, session never started) shows a visible "Download receipt" link that returns HTTP 404 when clicked. A customer who just books a session will see a broken download. This is a genuine correctness bug.

Minor precision note on the finding's wording: the receipt 404s whenever no sessions row exists, which is until the session is STARTED (not strictly "completed") — but this does not change the conclusion; the broken-link scenario for a freshly-booked upcoming session is exactly as described.

Suggested fix: filter the Receipts list to payments whose status is "captured" (the receipt only makes sense post-session), or gate the link/receipt route on session existence and hide the link otherwise. Files involved: app/(customer)/account/page.tsx (Receipts map ~line 164), lib/db/queries.ts:382 (listCustomerPayments has no status filter), app/(customer)/account/receipt/[bookingId]/route.ts:30.
